SP-003.1: a1: internal/procstat/identity_test.go TestStartTimeAndCwd covers this process and a /bin/sleep child started with Dir=t.TempDir(). Its start time falls inside the launch window and reads the same twice, and its cwd equals the temp dir. Related tests: TestIdentityMissingProcess, TestIdentityWithoutPATH (no PATH, so native only), TestNearestAncestor (real tree; a PID with another start time does not match), TestNearestAncestorWalk, TestIdentitySame, TestInvalidPID, TestParseStat, TestParseBootTime. All pass on darwin (Darwin 25.6.0, Apple M3 Max, go 1.26.5) and on linux (golang:1.26.5 container under Docker 28.5.1, linux/arm64), 2026-11-08. CI ubuntu-latest runs them too.

a2: BenchmarkStartTime, BenchmarkCwd and BenchmarkNearestAncestor (internal/procstat/identity_test.go), -count=3, 2026-11-08. darwin (M3 Max): StartTime 14.7-14.8 us/op, Cwd 1.35-1.39 us/op, full walk from the test process to launchd 0.12-0.13 ms/op. linux (container): StartTime 3.6-3.8 us/op, Cwd 0.49-0.50 us/op, full walk 11.2-11.4 us/op. Every single lookup is well under 1 ms.
SP-003.2: a1: In internal/procstat/identity_other.go (!darwin && !linux), readProc and Cwd return ErrUnsupported. TestIdentityUnsupported checks that StartTime and Cwd return ErrUnsupported and that NearestAncestor returns found=false with a nil error, so the caller gets no identity and no space. It ran and passed on GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm under node v26.13.0 via go_js_wasm_exec, 2026-11-08. TestNearestAncestorWalk/unsupported_is_no_identity passes on darwin, linux and js/wasm: a registered pid behind an ErrUnsupported reader gives found=false, err=nil. The test binary also compiles for windows, freebsd, openbsd and netbsd (go test -c).
